items.title: Puka Nacua: DNP due to hip injury
items.description:
Nacua didn't practice Friday due to a hip injury, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

items.title: Aaron Donald: Expects to play Monday
items.description:
Donald told Lindsey Thiry of ESPN.com on Friday, "That's the plan," when asked if he'll play Monday against the Giants.

items.title: George Kittle: Cleared for Week 2
items.description:
Kittle (Achilles) practiced fully Friday and does not have an injury designation for Week 2, according to David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

items.title: Brian Thomas: Cleared for Week 2 action
items.description:
Thomas (shoulder) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Denver, Ryan O'Halloran of the Florida Times-Union reports.

items.title: Jakobi Meyers: Ready for Week 2
items.description:
Meyers (thumb) was limited at Friday's practice but doesn't have an injury designation for Week 2 at Denver, Ryan O'Halloran of the Florida Times-Union reports.
